newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR AUSTRIA V ESTONIA WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR AUSTRIA V ESTONIA WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Teams for the World Cup group four qualifier between Austria and Estonia on Wednesday:

Austria: 1-Michael Konsel, 2-Harald Cerny, 3-Peter Schoettel, 4-Anton Pfeffer, 5-Wolfgang Feiersinger, 6-Andreas Heraf, 7-Ivica Vastic, 8-Dietmar Kuehbauer, 9-Anton Polster, 10-Andreas Herzog, 11-Arnold Wetl
Estonia: 1-Mart Poom, 2-Marek Lemsalu, 3-Urmas Kirs, 4-Sergei Hohlov-Simson, 5-Janek Meet, 6-Viktor Alonen, 7-Kristen Viikmae, 8-Mati Pari, 9-Marko Kristal, 10-Martin Reim, 11-Andres Oper
